other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi)
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar and apply in the district of permanent residence
Applicant must not be a government or semi‑government employee
Applicants from minority communities other than Muslims must submit a religious belief certificate issued by a recognized religious body
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹5,00,000 are provided to minority youth at a simple annual interest rate of 5% for generating employment.
